# bugs #3971: SIGSEGV for a string literal plus an offset in the initializer of a static pointer

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3971/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17192
- Recommended action: Apply the patch and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3971.patch](../../patches/bugs-3971.patch), commit [`3c690e2c4`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/3c690e2c42298672a32184e98618c24e7119ef30). Applies to r17192 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The compiler terminates with SIGSEGV for `"AAA" + 3` as the initializer of a `const char *` member
of a static object. For mcs51 and the struct of the ticket, which is not const, it crashes only
when the object is in xdata, as with `--model-large`. For a const object with such an initializer
it crashes in every model. It crashes for stm8 and z80 too.

## Cause

`constExprValue` in `src/SDCCast.c` identifies a string literal by the type of the node alone. The
sum `"AAA" + 3` has a copy of the array type of the literal. `constExprValue` therefore treats the
`+` node as the literal and reads the operator field of the node as a pointer to a value.

## Fix

`constExprValue` requires a symbol value node (`IS_AST_SYM_VALUE`) for a string literal. The sum
is then handled by the pointer-plus-constant case of `initPointer` in `src/SDCCglue.c`. The patch
makes two changes there. `initPointer` stores the symbol of the literal in the value that it
returns, and `printIvalCharPtr` adds the literal to `ccpStr` under the name of that symbol.
Without these two changes `emitStaticSeg` does not emit the string when a const object refers to
it with an offset, and the linker reports an undefined `__str_N` symbol.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-3971.c` has string literals with offsets in a struct that is not
const, in a const struct, and in plain and const pointers. `1 + "GHI"` is among them. Without the
patch the test does not compile for mcs51-large, stm8, and z80. With the patch it passes on the
host, for six mcs51 configurations (the four models, and small and large with `--stack-auto`), for
stm8, and for z80. The regression suite has no failures for mcs51-small and mcs51-large, and no
other test changes its code size. valdiag has no failures for mcs51, mcs51-large, and
mcs51-stack-auto.

## Related

- #3973 is a separate defect. This patch does not fix it.
- Two cases compile with and without the patch, and the string is not emitted: a string literal
  with an offset that initializes a pointer to a type other than `char` in a const object, as in
  `const void *v = "x" + 1`, and `&"x"[1]`. They are left for #3973.
